{{E|Upgrade Shrine}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Pray}} {{KW|Upgrade}} {{TS|positive||a card.}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
</div>

{{Frame|Pray}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The shrine's energy flows into you, making you stronger.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You ignore the shrine.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
